reviews.classification: historical dispatch / authored fill / evidence chronology / later integration
reviews.disposition:
Historical selected implementation dispatch under AD36/AD41/AD43. Preserve PC15–PC22 and every lane's distinct state: agitation/direction, thermal/scale, separation/vessel, cues/rescue/method, and stage/custody integration. Ingredient directions do not imply motion direction, summed heat is not a temperature trajectory, and an API/schema field without a consumer is not delivered behavior. HP two-day simmer/cauldron-wear pilot remains ORIGINAL; a bounded source locator is not a complete canonical stir algorithm. LOTM brew/ingest/digest/identity and mundane/original cultivation laws remain separate.

The shared contract's consumed/held inputs, revision, elapsed game time, committed intermediate, apparatus, controller and observation are owned facts to reconcile, not five parallel crafting engines. Cancellation cannot refund already committed input; preview cannot spend/draw; rescue/split cannot duplicate. Those are named original checks, not proof from a released pure function. Four pure lanes had finished and released work at the continuation check, while integration was active and G1/G2/G5/G6 interfaces remained dependencies. That checkpoint does not establish current workers, final connected PC18 gameplay or a completed persistence journey.

Later user continuation overrides the artificial percentage/finite-allowance/AU7 usage stops for the unfinished selected work. Actual service limits and the other scope/ownership/commit/push/save restrictions remain distinct. The existing integration had already received permission; no redundant restart/message was needed. THREADS and delivered follow-up messages establish dispatch/coordination rather than completion. Current content review reads the complete brief and late override, not each status/contract/runtime consumer. Old descendant/model/lock directions do not authorize new chats, workers or writes now. Preserve the named original consumer gaps and subsequent evidence in their native integration/status owners rather than treating this dispatch as final delivery.
reviews.evidence: Fresh full content read of all four complete files including final late authority, next boundaries, compaction notes and handoff. Later master checkpoint reused from actual full B485 reading this turn, not reopened runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: Retain useful detail and exact evidence boundary; named current consumer/source/verification gap controls any future work.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / authored fill / evidence chronology / later integration
reviews.disposition:
Historical six-intent consumer and authored currency fill under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve place aliases as translations/reused identities, and the repaired action origin versus destination distinction: an offered act starts where the player stands and moves on completion. One non-player relocation per act is a workaround, not an established cause/fix for KJ3E's freeze. Source-qualified purchase/fare costs and known private/public facts remain separate from banknote denominations, created item stock or full firearms behavior. Cane bought/loaded-round facts are knowledge/state markers here; inventories are asserted unchanged, so the cane is not a native usable inventory item.

The native arithmetic is internally consistent:2883 minus90 minus6 gives2787; minus27 gives2760. However the final27 includes an assumed three coppers, and2760 is therefore authored/assumed, not an exact canonical recovered purse. Keep the24-pence note component, unknown copper count and authored minutes explicit for kjw2 rather than laundering the final balance through an exact test. A changed dinner plan records closure through celebration.smaller while preserving the earlier treat promise key as history. Planned withdrawal and later range/legal consumers are not completed just by withholding/later-reader tables.

The whole-knowledge Nighthawk regex was unsuitable because Melissa already held an older invitation note; final new-key disclosure checks have narrower scope and do not erase that older knowledge. Prescan catches over-length strings, not semantic accuracy or current native line behavior. Two route attempts retain the first origin-place timeout and pack restore/rebuild; the second151-second seeded KJ3J route and literal import establish the named bundle/pack continuation. No font captures, civil-clock, ordinary-start, human or current shared-dist proof is added. The full receipt was read; private source, pack and runtime were not.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / authored fill / evidence chronology / later integration
reviews.disposition:
Historical replay procedure and qualified comparison, under AD36/AD43. The fixture uses a genuine historical test export through native import/load, then an explicit hero-name change and listed stock addition before native create/encode and second-model reload. It is a synthetic prepared fixture, not naturally earned resource acquisition or a personal save. The current merged-build step sequence and older fa10c/fa13 worker steps are separate evidence sets. Merely retaining a step file or executable command is not proof that it ran today.

Save/reload/Export/literal file-input Import comparisons span character, person inventories, expansion, calendar, location, NPCs/equipment with explicitly listed exporter-populated display caches. Preserve strict earlier cache-comparison failures and qualified replacements; a normalized/excluded-field result is not byte-exact full-state equality. Fatigue/debit observations and support-loss probes have their named scopes. Stopping wall-clock timers after a durable reservation isolates observation without editing game values, but it is still a special timing fixture rather than entirely ordinary uninterrupted live play.

Gzip compaction preserves original uncompressed bytes/hashes and requires decompression for the literal-import route; compacting evidence before the replay finishes could remove required inputs. Retained archive dispositions are history, not discarded coverage. The1600×1100 replay is its historical viewport, not present1920/1536/14/21 UI coverage. Old port, profiles and shell/repl instructions are recovery data and were not executed here. This full README review does not inspect fixture JSON, source probes, browser images, result files or current processes, and creates no regenerated bundle or renewed persistence proof.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / authored fill / evidence chronology / later integration
reviews.disposition:
Historical source-ready release with later integration pointer, under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve this lane's actual source-only status and failed-then-repaired missing-pin regression; it did not build or perform native acceptance. The complete [later master checkpoint](../master-reconciliation-2026-10-25/CHECKPOINT.md), fully read in B485, subsequently records combined integration and hp-native.cjs proof for inert admission, cancellation/refund, assessment, actual tutor-stock contribution, five persistence checkpoints and four desktop/text cases. It owns that later frozen input identity and combined suite, rather than retroactively claiming this lane ran them. Its later publication/adoption paragraph is yet another distinct stage. Today's document review independently verifies none of those artifacts or app/save states.

The selected original assessment/contribution consumes learned repair through actual means: supported wand/free hand, tutor, window, fragments, parchment/stamina, player pane and tutor-owned pane/XP. Enrollment grants none of them. Assessment success is not attendance, rank or mastery. Once-only finite classroom contribution is this authored optional task, not a universal frequency cap or canonical first-year syllabus. Mara, task quantities/timings and assessment values remain ORIGINAL proposals/adaptations. Term changes, holiday return and broader careers remain outside this unit.

The command-only extension keeps base hashes/D7 jobs separate, pins exact optional content only after durable publication, and uses existing structured/native owners. Pending jobs and settled completion/knowledge both need the pin; deleting one must refuse without mutation. Missing content suspends/preserves the life, rather than auto-adopting, resetting or substituting a fresh life. The later pin correction fixed the reproduced settled-state hole; a passing DOM dispatch test is not native browser acceptance. Preserve55/80/11 overlapping test scopes and prior import-harness failure, not their sum as a suite. The old LOTM build lock explains this lane's stop but is not current lock ownership. All paths were released in the original receipt; that is not present permission to overwrite concurrent edits. Existing world brief remains the scope owner; this reconciliation adds a specific later-evidence route instead of a new roadmap.
